business_summary: Bozhon Precision Industry Technology Co.,Ltd. engages in the research and development, design, production, and sale of automation equipment, automated flexible production lines, and automated key components and fixtures in China and internationally. The company offers consumer electronics manufacturing equipment; new energy lithium-ion battery manufacturing equipment; EV charging and battery swapping station; automobile electronics parts and process equipment; semiconductor manufacturing equipment; and smart warehouse and logistics products. It is also involved in industrial digitalization and intelligent workshop integration equipment, production lines, automated warehouses and software, industrial automation integration equipment, tooling and fixtures, new energy charging and discharging equipment, laser equipment, and laser equipment peripheral products; and consulting services for digital factories and intelligent manufacturing overall solutions. In addition, the company engages in research and development, production, and sales of new energy vehicle products, electromechanical equipment, industrial mobile vehicles, industrial mobile handling equipment, and related software; design, development, technical consultation, cloud platform services, and sales of information technology and network systems, big data products, and Internet of Things products; and leasing of self-owned properties; general road freight transportation. Further, it is involved in agency import and export business; general items: sales of office equipment and consumables; maintenance of electronic and mechanical equipment; sales of special chemical products; sales of inks; and sales of packaging equipment. The company was founded in 2001 and is headquartered in Suzhou, China.
